interface.signature: def validateBinaryTreeNodes(self, n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The lengths of leftChild and rightChild must both equal n.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= leftChild[i] <= n - 1 for i in range(n)) and all(-1 <= rightChild[i] <= n - 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All values in leftChild and rightChild must be between -1 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if all nodes form exactly one valid binary tree.
The function returns False if the nodes do not form a valid binary tree.
